description: Conversion an existing barn into residential accommodation associated with Osterley Park Farmhouse
decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (OFHB-PR-03C, OFHB-PR-04C received 6 July 2021; Energy Statement 20 April 2021 received 20 April 2021; OFHB-EX-01, OFHB-EX-02, Heritage and design and access statements and flood risk assessment received 15 February 2021) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The existing materials used on the external surfaces of the building shall be carefully removed and stored at the outset of the development works where necessary and shall be re-used to clad the finished structure.  Any materials that need to be added or replaced to make good shortfalls shall match the existing in type, colour, dimensions, texture and coursing and (in the case of brickwork) the mortar used shall be lime mortar formulated to ensure that future damage to the brickwork shall not arise as a result of any necessary re-pointing.
Condition : 4 - Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) Order 2015 (or any Order amending or revoking and re-enacting that Order), no extensions and alterations falling within Classes A, B, C, D and E of Schedule 2 Part 1 to that Order shall be carried out.
Condition : 5 - No new materials or external finishes such as staining or paint shall be incorporated into the external faces of the building unless they have first been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.
Condition : 6 - No new plumbing, pipes, soil stacks, flues, vents, grills, security alarms or ductwork shall be fixed on the external faces of the building unless shown on the drawings hereby approved.  External ironmongery, guttering and pipework shall be iron, steel or aluminium and shall be painted black
Condition : 7 - a)	Notwithstanding the energy statement hereby approved, in addition to the approved measures, other than initial site preparation and clearance the development hereby permitted shall not commence until a revised energy statement has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local planning Authority to show the use of photovoltaic panels on the south west roof face to a specification that shall be installed before the building is brought into use if such details are agreed by the local planning authority.
b)	The development shall be implemented in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy and other than initial site preparation shall not commence until full Design Stage calculations under the Standard Assessment Procedure have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local planning Authority to show that the development will be constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.
c)	Prior to first occupation of the hereby approved development evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions
Condition : 8 - Prior to first occupation of the approved development evidence (e.g. photographs, installation contracts and As-Built certificates under the Standard Assessment Procedure) shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority and approved in writing to show that the development has been constructed in accordance with the approved Energy Strategy, and any subsequent approved revisions.
Condition : 9 - Prior to first occupation of the approved development, evidence (schedule of fittings and manufacturers' literature) demonstrating that the development of that phase has been constructed to achieve an internal water consumption by the development not exceeding 105 litres/person/day in line with The Water Efficiency Calculator for new dwellings issued by the Ministry for Housing, Communities and Local Government, shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 10 - The house hereby approved shall be used solely as a single family house (Use Class C3) or as a 'granny annexe' in connection with the use of the 'Old Farmhouse' and shall not be used for business purposes and or as a house in multiple occupation, including any use within Class C4 of The Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) or such other legislation as may subsequently supersede it.
Condition : 11 - The private garden area hereby approved shall be created as shown before the accommodation is first occupied and permanently retained.
Condition : 12 - The building is required to meet the following sustainable materials standards and shall not be occupied until evidence (e.g. photographs and copies of delivery notes, invoices or installation contracts) have been submitted to the Local Planning Authority to demonstrate that the development meets the following:
"	At least three of the key elements of the building envelope (external walls, windows roof, upper floor slabs, internal walls, floor finishes/coverings) are to achieve a rating of A+ to D in the Building Research Establishment (BRE) The Green Guide of specification.
"	At least 50% of timber and timber products are to be sourced from accredited Forest Stewardship Council (FSC) or Programme for the Endorsement of Forestry Certification (PEFC) scheme.
"	No construction or insulation materials are to be used which will release toxins into the internal and external environment, including those that deplete stratospheric ozone.
